charts.title: K2-199 c: orbits around K2-199
charts.description: The orbits of K2-199's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-199 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Akana Murphy et al. 2021 (2021AJ....162..294A), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname AKANA_MURPHY_ET_AL__2021): P 7.3744897 d

charts.title: K2-199 c: its transit
charts.description: K2-199 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 1 sector (91) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 2621212, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 10-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 10-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
